verdict.rationale: dlt is a code-only Python library documented to run wherever Python runs, including Airflow, Dagster, Lambda/serverless functions and containers. The docs point to a GitHub Actions deployment guide, and the CLI handles deploying pipelines (including a single `dlthub deploy` command), so headless and CI automation is a first-class use. A community user also stresses doing everything via code. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CI runs, and only a passing mention of the GitHub Actions guide rather than detailed CI docs in the pack.
